body.message: The 2BR at Elite Business Bay checks both boxes on furnished and all-inclusive. Two things I do need to confirm with the team though: our pricing is structured in 3-month blocks, so a locked rate across two consecutive 6-month terms needs sign-off, and the same goes for 4, 5 occupants on a 2BR. What's the budget you're working with so I can bring everything to them in one go?
